author: jaszczurovsky
body:
The new best event for Summoner was 2 months wgo (new Yggdrasil with gear giving more summon from start), if you have any clothes from that tree (summon spell start 50%), then try it.

I'd heavily recommend to you to seek for Arisen Rift Summoner Helmet in case you would like to switch to GSH (I recommend it especially for raids), but also does the job with Blood Pact on base GS.

Nothing else is very crucial from this event (Omega riftlock is a must, but you have one already). New gear with ward absorbtion, and pact effectiveness might be interesting for some gear optimisation, but not so must have.

For endless you should more look for Ophion Banner, but that's not from Riftfall. From Yelbeghen I hope you also found something with disperse chance (so you can buff not only you but also all of your summons). Also Peluda summon from Wyrmhun is more important for you than gear from this event (except that helmet for pacts).

Edit: don't focus on summon stats from gear, because you already have 220% from Auriga and 130% from benefactor. 15-20% added to those values are not making the difference.

author: StressSuitable
body:
If you have enough shards - best ward weapon is celestial axe.

For the rest - it's stacking ward and hp where possible.

All in all this looks good, except maybe boots.

author: dreambig5
body:
Here is a link for the class guides: [https://www.reddit.com/r/OrnaRPG/comments/1rnnzqv/comment/o989aot/?utm\_source=share&utm\_medium=web3x&utm\_name=web3xcss&utm\_term=1&utm\_content=share\_button](https://www.reddit.com/r/OrnaRPG/comments/1rnnzqv/comment/o989aot/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=web3x&utm_name=web3xcss&utm_term=1&utm_content=share_button)

Spiked Greatshield, Arisen Riftguard Helmet, Arisen Riftrogue Chestplate, Arisen Riftrogue boots, Arisen Riftrogue Leggings, Arisen Rift Summoner Plate, and Soul of Charon.

This is a good resource to look up who to get what from: [https://codex.fqegg.top/#/](https://codex.fqegg.top/#/)

Last month was actually really good for summoners (Yelmogus gear, Fallen Sky Leggins for not having to worry about ward, and summon Peluda spell for AoE). Rather than benefactor amity I just use whatever my best ward recovery is. 

Get yourself a celestial axe & celestial staff! Use the axe for tougher battles (3-4 adorns with highest ward, and 1-2 with highest ward recovery), use the staff for turn reducing & magic benefits.

\----

Personally, I have enough ascension levels so I feel safe with 50-60k ward, so I use Celestial Staff  with Arisen Shield (212% ward). Also I used to run high anguish but I realized I was just making it needlessly hard for myself so I switched back to Ang Lvl 1.

For Boss Horde Dungeons, I use Ruairc gear to get more enemies in Dungeon Horde (still use Fallen Sky Leggings w/Celestial staff quicker spell casts/summons, &/or throw in one of the pieces of gear from Dynasty which has Gods of Aaru spell (really handy in towers. Dungeons, I always like starting with Ancient Dragon, and Phaeton summon. Ward of Ortanite, Divine Bastion II, Summon rest of peludes & then deific channel or Gods of Aaru if I have that gear on, Wyrms song, Rhada Pact II. Just repeat the last 3 spells until that dungeon is done. 

\*NOT the way to go for endless dungeons!\* This is just for boss horde.

Towers: Start with Ancient Dragon summon, and one Peluda. Summon additional pedulas, gods of Aaru & rhada pact 2. Really good at clearing at almost everything in the towers).

For Monuments, celestial staff, arisen terror, mightiest mimic head, court jester plate, & Arisen Jolly Stockings (because they're so easy to clear & it maximizes exp, luck, & gold/orns).

For Raids, I USED to go celestial staff/axe with Arisen spiritgarm grimoire.....which was fine but it can be slow. Now I just use Beo, Deity or Realmy (I built those using the class guides above). Works fairly well.
